en.5804c2b5: Adults take 0.5 to 1 g of sodium bicarbonate per 1 dose, 3 to 5 g per 1 day. Also adjust the dose appropriately according to age and symptoms.
en.8b221822: Adults take 1 to 2 tablets (0.5 to 1 g) per dose, 6 to 10 tablets (3 to 5 g) per 1 day. Adjust the dose appropriately according to age and symptoms.

en.10e6bda1: Do not take this medicine if you need to restrict sodium intake (such as with hypernatremia, edema (swelling), preeclampsia, bladder stones, or high blood pressure). Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have severe digestive tract ulcers, kidney disorders, heart function disorders, lung function disorders, or electrolyte imbalance such as hypochloremic alkalosis, or have congestive heart failure, edema, or sodium retention, as well as reduced urine output (oliguria) or no urine output (anuria).
en.358bda9e: Do not take this medicine if you need to restrict sodium intake (such as with hypernatremia, edema, preeclampsia, bladder stones, or high blood pressure), or have hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have severe digestive tract ulcers, kidney disorders, heart function disorders, lung function disorders, electrolyte imbalance such as hypochloremic alkalosis, congestive heart failure, edema, sodium retention, reduced urine output (oliguria), or no urine output (anuria).

en.851900a0: This medicine should be used with caution in patients with severe digestive tract ulcers, kidney disorders, heart function disorders, lung function disorders, or electrolyte imbalance such as hypochloremic alkalosis.
en.c7a0f915: Use this medicine with caution in patients with congestive heart failure, edema (swelling), or sodium retention, as well as reduced urine output (oliguria) or no urine output (anuria). When taking it for excess stomach acid, take it on an empty stomach before meals, and to reduce irritation from carbon dioxide gas, take it combined with other antacids.
en.1c1c5e61: This medicine raises the pH of the digestive tract and body fluids, which may affect the absorption and excretion of medicines taken together, so use it with caution. Taking it with large amounts of milk or calcium preparations may cause milk-alkali syndrome (hypercalcemia, azotemia, alkalosis, etc.), so consult a doctor or pharmacist.
en.8cb5591e: Taking this medicine with large amounts of milk or calcium preparations may cause milk-alkali syndrome (hypercalcemia, azotemia, alkalosis, etc.), so consult a doctor or pharmacist.
en.78730db0: If alkalosis or edema due to sodium accumulation occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
